content:
jess: heads up — ran a 6h profiling pass on batch formation across hw matrix. noticing weird drop on H100 when kv-frag > 12%
omar: drop how big?
sue: can you paste perf numbers and the config you used?
jess: baseline a100/h100/a10/t4/l4 run. peak tokens/s at steady state: A10 18.2k, T4 11.4k, L4 14.1k, A100 41.6k, H100 37.9k -> after a few hours H100 slid to 28.7k
ken: that smell like kv-cache fragmentation + kernel fallback thrash to me
jess: yep saw kernel selector flip logs: 
```
[kernel-selector] model=gptx_v2 seq=1024 -> kernel=cu_attn_f32
[kernel-selector] kv_frag=0.11 -> keep
[kernel-selector] kv_frag=0.15 -> fallback to cu_attn_mixed -> increased latency
```
omar: what were batch-token ceilings?
jess: standard policy from last week: 
```
max_tokens_per_batch: {"A10": 12000, "T4": 7000, "L4": 9000, "A100": 48000, "H100": 48000}
slot_ceiling_margin: 0.12
```
sue: 48k on H100 feels high when kv-frag accumulates. fragmentation increases memory stride and kernel candidates shrink -> more fallbacks
ken: we should try per-card softer ceiling for H100 and add kv-frag gating: if kv_frag>0.1 reduce max_tokens_per_batch by 20%
jess: I ran a quick sim with gating: H100 target -> 48k *0.8 = 38.4k, steady state returned to 36.9k and no kernel flip churn. experiment logs: throughput stabilized, p50 latency +12ms but p99 improved 180ms -> fewer spikes
omar: nice. can you drop the config snippet for ops to roll?
jess: proposed patch for rollout: 
```
batch_policy:
  per_gpu:
    H100:
      max_tokens_per_batch: 38400
      kv_frag_gating:
        threshold: 0.10
        reduction: 0.20
    A100:
      max_tokens_per_batch: 46000
    A10:
      max_tokens_per_batch: 12000
    T4:
      max_tokens_per_batch: 7000
    L4:
      max_tokens_per_batch: 9000
  safety_floor_pct: 0.6
  fallback_cooldown_s: 30
```
ken: add note to disable automatic kernel fallbacks during warmup window maybe 120s, so we don't thrash when kv cache is populating
sue: also add telemetry tags: rollout_id, kv_frag_at_rollout, kernel_fallback_count. we'll need to correlate to incidents
benchbot: perf-bench completed: h100-gate-sim -> before: p99=1.12s, after: p99=0.93s, tokens/s steady: before=28.7k, after=36.9k
jess: great. plan: canary 5% of H100 pools with new policy, monitor for 2 hours, then 25% if stable. I'll open the rollout PR and include the sim traces
omar: please include a short-run playbook in PR: how to roll back, metric cutoffs for abort (p99 regress > +10% or kernel_fallback_count increases x2)
ken: one more thought — for mixed-card allocation, ensure scheduler doesn't pack large H100 batches with L4 jobs; prefer homogeneous slotting or enforce packing ratios
jess: noted. I'll add a reference to slot_affinity rules in the PR
sue: thanks — tagging infra-oncall and perf to watch the canary. :thumbsup:
jess: PR link when ready, will post here. thanks all.
